note: The 80 thumbnails the founder supplied on 26 November 2026, the 50 subjects they show, the ten worlds and the museum records each subject is joined to. The thumbnails are pictures and titles for a video series; they are not historical sources, and nothing here is a historical claim. The pictures are not in git: gaming/media/hudhud/source/ holds them on a machine that has the archive. Written by gen script from the archive's own index and a hand-made mapping; checked by src/tests/atlas.gtest.ts and tools/check-sources.py.

archive.status: supplied by the founder; the index says the English pictures are the files downloaded back from YouTube and the Arabic ones are finished files not yet uploaded. How the pictures were made is not stated in the archive.
